provenance.extraction: Serialized public definitions from the active blue bundle; HTTP transport not captured.

capabilities.title: H-SWAE semantic tissue search
capabilities.description: Resolve a tissue or cell-context phrase against the loaded H-SWAE V1 TISSUE embedding index. Tissue-scoped: a cell-type phrase resolves only if it carries a tissue alias. An empty `matches` carries `unmatched_reason` and the `searched_vocabularies` that were consulted, so a miss is never readable as a biological absence. For cell-type-grain work use hswae.v2.resolve_cell_type and hswae.v2.compare_cell_types.

capabilities.title: H-SWAE surface marker ranking
capabilities.description: Rank surface markers for a TISSUE context resolved by the H-SWAE V1 index. `context` is matched against the tissue vocabulary only; a cell-type phrase that misses it returns a context_not_resolved error naming hswae.v2.compare_cell_types, which ranks markers at cell-type grain. Results carry markers_requested vs markers_returned plus the exclusion counts, because absence from the top list is ranking truncation, not a measured zero.

capabilities.title: H-SWAEV2 cell-type resolution
capabilities.description: Resolve a cell-type phrase against the FIXED HPA v25 single-cell vocabulary (~202 labels from hpa_v25_single_cell_cluster plus the specialized reference contexts) — not an open Cell Ontology, so an ontology-style phrasing may need the returned nearest_candidates to pick a label. Returns resolution_status, the resolution_stage that matched, always-populated nearest_candidates, unresolved_reason, and the vocabulary scope actually searched. resolution_status: "unresolved" means the phrase missed the vocabulary; it is never evidence that the cell type is absent from the atlas.

capabilities.title: H-SWAEV2 differential cell-context specificity
capabilities.description: Compare a target cell type against an explicit delivery-aware comparator scope, over the fixed HPA v25 single-cell vocabulary (~202 labels). Read `differential` as a measured contrast ONLY when differential_status is "computed"; the other values ("target_unresolved", "no_references_resolved", "no_rows_above_threshold") name what was missing, and reference_resolution reports which requested references resolved. This is the cell-type-grain counterpart to hswae.v1.surface_markers.

capabilities.title: H-SWAEV2 isoform expression
capabilities.description: Return transcript and isoform specificity for one gene. `resolution` is the backend CLAIM about available grain; `observed_resolution` reports what the returned rows actually contain, and every row carries context_resolution ("tissue" or "cell_type"). The two may disagree — trust observed_resolution for any cell-type claim, and read a null cell_type on a context row as "this row is tissue-resolved", never as "no cell type was found".

capabilities.title: H-SWAEV2 dataset annotation
capabilities.description: Annotate an already-authorized user dataset against the existing H-SWAEV2 atlas.

capabilities.title: Predictive interactomics complex specificity
capabilities.description: Score required subunits by same-cell co-expression using the H-SWAEV2 complex-specificity head.
